verdict.rationale: UKVI publishes processing times itself. There is a dedicated GOV.UK page ('Visa processing times: applications outside the UK') with dated change notes, plus an online service that tells applicants when to expect a decision. Missing for 10: evidence that times are listed for the Innovator Founder route specifically, evidence of published times for in-UK extensions or switches, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the times are current and accurate.
